assignment: India Wikipedia multilingual BPE tokenizer fertility fairness

validation.contract: The decoded output must contain exactly the same non-whitespace characters in the same order. Whitespace normalization is reported separately.

method.corpus: Live Wikipedia plain-text extracts for full India article body + headings; TextExtracts/plaintext removes tables and infoboxes, and the cleaner cuts reference/see-also/external-link sections by heading.
method.initial_units: Unicode grapheme/akshara-like clusters, not raw Unicode codepoints
method.training_weighting: objective-guided constrained greedy BPE: candidate merges are scored by estimated reduction in fertility X, with dynamic pressure for English while X > 1.2 and for languages far above the minimum X. No text is deleted or sampled for the submitted score.
method.optimization_strategy: grapheme-cluster BPE + constrained greedy merge selection + integer-ID word-frequency training + candidate configuration search
method.train_eval_split: assignment metric uses full article text; held-out diagnostic separately trains on first 80% and evaluates on last 20%
method.why_holdout: The held-out diagnostic is shown only as a sanity check. It helps detect whether a 10k BPE vocabulary is memorising article-specific whole words.
method.ratio_definition: X = total BPE tokens after grapheme-cluster BPE encoding of the full cleaned article / whitespace word units in the same full cleaned article
method.faithful_unit_definition: One contiguous Unicode letter/mark/number run, or one visible non-whitespace punctuation/symbol character.
method.faithful_ratio_definition: faithful X = total BPE tokens / faithful units in the same full cleaned article

optimizer_diagnostics.internal_training_representation: tuple[int, ...] per unique word; pair keys are tuple[int, int]
optimizer_diagnostics.corpus_deduplication: per-language Counter: unique whitespace word -> frequency
optimizer_diagnostics.explanation: Training uses integer ID tuples and per-language word-frequency dictionaries. Each legal BPE merge is still exported as readable string merge rules in tokenizer.json.
